title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover ordering under thrash
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Context: Customers experienced regional thrashing during a cross-region traffic spike which exposed a race in the SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering. Symptoms included: backoff timers not being honored after a failover, double-invocation of fallback paths, and rapid toggling of regional routing which caused cascading load-shedding. This PR is a hotfix to address the race and reduce sensitivity during high churn. What this changes: single continuous description below (implementation details, tests, rollout plan): - Fixes a race between the SLO enforcer's backoff scheduler and the regional-failover coordinator by introducing an ordering gate: when a failover decision is in-flight, backoff state transitions are serialized for the affected service shards. - Adds hysteresis to the regional failover decision (30s min stable window) to avoid oscillation under transient metric noise. - Caps exponential backoff growth and adds deterministic jitter seed to avoid synchronized retries across regions. - Improves metrics and tracing: new trace span `slo_enforcer.failover_gate` and metrics `slo_enforcer.failover_gate_blocked` and `slo_enforcer.backoff_applied` for alerting. - Adds an integration test that simulates concurrent failover + backoff events and verifies no double failover and stable routing decisions for at least the hysteresis window. Notes: This is a targeted hotfix (no API changes). Related: SUP-3421 (support ticket from customer X), ENG-1248 (incidence postmortem), ENG-1280 (follow-up stabilization work).

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Important change - can we ensure that the ordering gate doesn't introduce a deadlock with the shard rebalancer? Please add a unit test that simulates a stuck gate.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added a non-blocking lock and a watchdog in enforcer.go; included an extra unit test `gate_watchdog_test` to simulate stuck state (see commit h7i8j9k).

Ava Rodriguez: CI flaked on the integration test first run (timeout). Re-ran and it passed - please keep an eye on test timeout thresholds. Also suggest adding a small deterministic seed to jitter for reproducibility (good to have in logs).
Marcus Liu: Approve after minor telemetry naming nit fixed (replaced metric `slo_enforcer.failover_gate` -> `slo_enforcer.failover_gate_blocked`).
ci_logs_summary: Initial CI: failed (integration timeout) -> rerun -> all checks passed (unit tests, integration, lint, go vet). Flaky test adjustments: raised integration test timeout from 30s to 90s and added deterministic seeding.
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover ordering. Adds ordering gate, hysteresis window, capped backoff with jitter, new telemetry and integration tests. Fixes regional thrashing and double-fallback invocations observed during cross-region spike (SUP-3421).
